summary: Bluemount Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, disclosing a change in its Chief Financial Officer. Ms. Lui Tung Mui resigned for personal reasons, effective immediately, with no disagreement with the company. The board appointed Mr. Chan Ka Ki, former CFO of Incredible Holdings Limited (2014–2024), as the new CFO, effective the same day. His appointment has no fixed term and is terminable on one-month notice. This is a standard management change filing with no special-situation deal terms; the filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other event-driven corporate action. No deal terms, advisors, or regulatory clocks were disclosed.
